rounds.summary: Fresh read-back confirms the original transfer is cancelled with no funds held. Correct the payee, fund USD via the quoted EUR-to-USD conversion, retry the USD transfer, and defer the queued payout to preserve the USD reserve.

Last arrival says PROCESSING, created_at order says CANCELLED. Using created_at and GET /api/v1/transfers/{id}.

modelFindings.detail: The fx buy of 28,000 USD is sized exactly as retry 40,000 − current 22,000 + reserve 10,000, i.e. to land precisely on the 10,000 floor with zero allowance for the deferral. But the defer_payout places a 7,000 ledger hold (fact 6) and the reserve check counts deferrals (fact 7). Net free USD after all moves = 22,000 + 28,000 − 40,000 − 7,000 = 3,000, which is 7,000 below the 10,000 floor. The retry itself will execute (≈43,000 available after hold+fx covers 40,000), but the run ends with the account encumbered below its required reserve. The plan over-commits USD by 7,000; the fx buy_amount must also cover the deferred hold (or the deferral/scope must change).

Quote 67a7a79b is valid only 14:00–14:15 and now = 14:00, a 15-minute window. Human approval comes after this review and the executor runs after approval; if that exceeds the window, fx_conversion fails and the run halts before retry_transfer, so the supplier is never paid. Approve and execute inside the window, or re-quote at run time.

modelFindings.detail: Original transfer 43217eec-6053-4fe6-b760-[digits] is CANCELLED with pending 0 and reserved 0, so it holds no money. correct_beneficiary only updates the payee; it does not create a new Airwallex transfer. No retry_transfer move is filed, so the executor will not reissue the 40,000 USD payment.

If the canceled 40,000 USD transfer is to be retried, no fx_conversion move is proposed. USD available is 22,000 and the reserve floor is 10,000, so at least 28,000 USD must be sourced externally; if the deferred 7,000 USD marketing payout remains a ledger hold, the 28,000 USD quote would still leave a 7,000 USD shortfall.

The deferral of queued_marketing_7000 is released only 'after supplier settles'. Since the supplier transfer is CANCELLED and no retry is proposed in this move set, ensure there is a verifiable settlement event; otherwise the marketing retainer could remain deferred indefinitely.
Quote f27afcd8-ea2c-43ed-bb5d-f43010e07eb0 is valid only until 2026-11-02T14:15:00+0000. If an fx_conversion is added, it must be executed before that time.

modelFindings.detail: The FX conversion funds exactly 28,000 USD: 22,000 existing + 28,000 = 50,000 USD; the 40,000 USD retry leaves 10,000 USD. The 7,000 USD marketing payout is only deferred, not cancelled, and the reserve floor is checked after deferrals. Treating that deferred payout as a committed hold leaves only 3,000 USD above the required 10,000 USD reserve floor. Add 7,000 USD of funding or change the deferral terms so the reserve floor is met.
